message: Amounts are exact: no float anywhere money is held, parsed or summed. Use Decimal or integer minor units. See CLAUDE.md § Security boundaries.
Tally never makes a network connection. See CLAUDE.md § Security boundaries.

A raw control character (C0 but tab and line feed, or DEL) is in source: an escape written in a tool call can arrive as the character itself. Write chr(0x1B) or an escape instead. See CLAUDE.md § Lessons.
